result.title: A four-view smartphone video dataset of a robot-held flexible strip, with camera poses and a 3D LaGSplat baseline
result.comment: 2 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. Dataset and checkpoints: doi:10.5281/zenodo.23601189. Training code: https://github.com/LouenPottier/lagsplat-mpov. Interactive demo: https://louenpottier.github.io/xrdays.html
result.summary: This note describes a multi-view video dataset of a deformable object driven by a measured input, with the measured pose of every camera, and a first 3D result obtained on it with LaGSplat. LaGSplat learns from video a low-dimensional latent state that is both the generalized coordinate of a learned dissipative Lagrangian and the conditioning variable of a Gaussian Splatting decoder; fitting the decoder in 3D calls for synchronized multi-view footage, which the original paper only had from synthetic renderings. Here a robot arm moves a flexible strip by oscillating along a one-dimensional path, and four iPhones, three fixed and one handheld, film it for ten minutes. The videos are synchronized, the cameras are posed from the scene, and the position of the gripper is given per frame as the input of the system. LaGSplat fitted on this data with the gripper acceleration as a forcing term renders held-out views at 26 to 33 dB PSNR and runs as a real-time interactive demo in a web browser. Dataset, checkpoints and training code are public.

AI.brief_summary: 论文发布一个四视角手机视频数据集：机械臂沿一维轨迹摆动柔性带，四台 iPhone 拍摄十分钟同步视频并给出相机位姿与夹爪逐帧位置，并在其上运行 LaGSplat 基线（以低维 latent 状态同时作为耗散拉格朗日广义坐标与 Gaussian Splatting 解码条件），留出视角渲染达 26–33 dB PSNR。
AI.relevance_reason: 其中「低维 latent 状态 + 外部输入驱动力 + 解码器」的结构，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态如何由输入更新、低维压缩是否丢失任务必要信息提供类比核查线索，但该文目标是重建与渲染而非推理。
